metadata.description: LCT realtime caption-translation eval set: inputs mimic what on-device ASR (SpeechAnalyzer / Live Captions) actually emits: short turns, unfinished drafts, no punctuation, fillers, numbers and names.
metadata.scoring: latency (TTFT/E2E/TPS, client-side, streaming), instruction compliance (no preamble / think / markers / echo), term preservation (numbers, names, tech terms), hallucination guard (length ratio), chrF vs reference

system_prompt:
You are a professional simultaneous interpreter. Translate the text enclosed in 🔤 markers to {TARGET_LANGUAGE}.

CRITICAL RULES:
1. Output ONLY the translated text, never the original text
2. Handle incomplete sentences naturally and professionally
3. Preserve technical terms, company names, and proper nouns
4. Keep numbers, dates and units exactly as spoken
5. Never add explanations, notes, or commentary
6. If the text is a fragment, translate the fragment as-is without completing it

D_numbers_names.description: 数字、日期、货币、人名公司名必须原样保留

cases.input: Revenue grew 12% year over year to $4.3 billion.
cases.reference: 收入同比增长12%，达到43亿美元。

cases.input: Sarah from Stripe will join us on March 15th at 3 p.m.
cases.reference: Stripe的Sarah将在3月15日下午3点加入我们。

cases.input: We processed 2.7 million requests with a p99 latency of 180 milliseconds.
cases.reference: 我们处理了270万个请求，p99延迟为180毫秒。

cases.input: Microsoft and OpenAI announced the partnership in Q2 2024.
cases.reference: Microsoft和OpenAI在2024年第二季度宣布了合作。

cases.input: The budget is 850 thousand euros, split 60-40 between the two teams.
cases.reference: 预算是85万欧元，两个团队按60比40分配。

cases.input: Dr. Nakamura's team at Stanford published the results on arXiv last Tuesday.
cases.reference: Nakamura博士在斯坦福的团队上周二在arXiv上发表了结果。

cases.input: Version 3.2.1 fixes the bug reported in ticket LCT-418.
cases.reference: 3.2.1版本修复了工单LCT-418中报告的问题。

cases.input: Our NPS went from 31 to 47 after the redesign.
cases.reference: 改版后我们的NPS从31升到了47。

E_tech_terms.description: 技术/产品术语，保留英文或用标准译法

cases.input: We migrated the service from Kubernetes to a single Rust binary on bare metal.
cases.reference: 我们把这个服务从Kubernetes迁移到了裸金属上的单个Rust二进制。

cases.input: The model runs fully on-device with Metal acceleration and a 4-bit quantized Qwen checkpoint.
cases.reference: 模型完全在设备端运行，使用Metal加速和4位量化的Qwen检查点。

cases.input: Enable WASAPI loopback so we capture system audio without a virtual device.
cases.reference: 启用WASAPI环回，这样不需要虚拟设备也能采集系统音频。

cases.input: The API returns a 429 when you exceed the rate limit, so add exponential backoff.
cases.reference: 超过速率限制时API会返回429，所以要加指数退避。

cases.input: We're seeing GPU memory pressure because num_ctx defaults to 32K.
cases.reference: 我们遇到了GPU内存压力，因为num_ctx默认是32K。

cases.input: The PR adds a TranslationEngine protocol with an Ollama adapter and an embedded llama.cpp runtime.
cases.reference: 这个PR增加了TranslationEngine协议，带有一个Ollama适配器和一个内置的llama.cpp运行时。

cases.input: Notarization requires a Developer ID certificate and the hardened runtime.
cases.reference: 公证需要Developer ID证书和强化运行时。

cases.input: Our CI runs on windows-latest, which no longer ships NSIS.
cases.reference: 我们的CI跑在windows-latest上，它不再自带NSIS。

F_long_sentences.description: 讲座/会议里的长句，30-45 词

cases.input: What I want to emphasize today is that the transition to on-device inference is not primarily about cost, it's about latency and privacy, and those two things are what actually change user behavior.
cases.reference: 我今天想强调的是，向设备端推理的转变主要不是为了成本，而是为了延迟和隐私，而这两点才是真正改变用户行为的因素。

cases.input: Before we commit to the Q3 roadmap, I'd like each team lead to send me a one-page summary of their top three risks and what support they need from leadership to mitigate them.
cases.reference: 在我们确定第三季度路线图之前，我希望每位团队负责人给我发一页纸的摘要，说明他们最主要的三个风险，以及需要管理层提供什么支持来缓解这些风险。

cases.input: If the benchmark shows that the embedded runtime is within twenty percent of the Ollama path on first-token latency, I'm comfortable making it the default and keeping Ollama as an advanced option.
cases.reference: 如果基准测试显示内置运行时的首字延迟与Ollama路径相差在百分之二十以内，我可以接受把它设为默认，并把Ollama保留为高级选项。

cases.input: The reason the microphone channel picks up the speaker audio is simply acoustic feedback, so with headphones the duplicate lines disappear, but we should still say that in onboarding.
cases.reference: 麦克风通道会拾取扬声器声音的原因就是声学回授，所以戴上耳机重复的字幕就会消失，但我们仍然应该在引导里说明这一点。

cases.input: Historically every attempt to bundle a second inference server inside a desktop app has failed on maintenance cost, so the question is whether a statically linked library changes that calculus.
cases.reference: 历史上每一次在桌面应用里捆绑第二个推理服务的尝试都败在了维护成本上，所以问题在于静态链接的库是否改变了这个算计。

cases.input: Let's park the pricing discussion, because until we know whether enterprise customers actually need SSO and audit logs, any number we put on the slide is going to be a guess.
cases.reference: 我们先把定价讨论放一放，因为在知道企业客户是否真的需要SSO和审计日志之前，我们放在幻灯片上的任何数字都只是猜测。
